intent_snapshot.goal: Ship the Immune-Brain storage-layout cutover release: make ignored `.imm/state/` the sole mutable Kernel authority store, make tracked per-task `.imm/audit/` the sole terminal evidence store, transfer terminal ownership through one recoverable exact-replay settlement transaction, add a one-release automatic claimless legacy-layout migrator shared by stateful CLI and Pi entrypoints that performs no Git index writes and stops the triggering operation until its diff is committed, preserve explicit historical v3 audit without authority, and delete retired project-local template, MEMORY, active-v2 compatibility, and current contract surfaces while retaining an explicit immediate-successor deletion boundary for the migrator.

acceptance.assertion: Kernel Enrollment and active execution use only `.imm/state/`, while completion and stop recoverably converge a create-once matching `.imm/audit/<task-id>/task-record.json` plus `terminal-proof.json`, clear workspace/claim/active state only after the audit pair is durable, and classify every marker/duplicate/stale-claim combination with the Spec's fail-closed precedence.

The one-release migrator accepts only owner-free, transaction-free, affected-path-clean legacy layouts; holds old and new locks; freezes a hash manifest; relocates terminal and v3 machine evidence byte-for-byte; rejects unknown, symlinked, escaped, case-colliding, dirty, active, or conflicting inputs; recovers every interruption exactly; never mutates the Git index; stops the original mutation; and blocks retry until affected paths are committed.

Every stateful `imm-kernel` and native Pi entrypoint uses one layout inspection contract: status, audit, validation, and preparation remain zero-write and report migration/recovery requirements without interpreting old authority, while explicit mutation performs eligible migration or recovery and returns before TaskIntent authoring or Enrollment authority commit.

Known legacy v3 machine evidence is preserved under `.imm/audit/legacy-v3/` and remains securely readable through explicit bounded audit, but status, preparation, projection, mutation, and terminal settlement cannot treat it as current authority or synthesize a TaskRecord from it.

`.imm/state/` is wholly ignored and excluded from task diff identity, `.imm/audit/` is wholly trackable and task-ID-isolated, every terminal archived TaskIntent has matching durable audit evidence, and retired `.imm/templates/`, `.imm/memory/MEMORY.md`, active-v2 migrator source, and current contract/test ownership are deleted while historical archived references remain factual.

Current architecture, operator guidance, package runtime smoke, and generated reference mirrors describe the state/audit layout, automatic migrate-and-stop release sequence, Git-only pre-Enrollment rollback boundary, historical-audit isolation, and immediate-successor migrator deletion without stale current old-layout contracts.

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/storage_layout_migration.ts: convergeRelocation returns when matching source and target both exist instead of deleting the verified source, so an interruption after target creation leaves duplicate legacy authority and recovery falsely removes the marker; verify replay removes the source and retains the exact target bytes.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/storage_layout_migration.ts: migration leaves emptied .imm/tasks, .imm/memory, and .imm/templates directories, while inspectOldLayout treats those directories as legacy authority, so a completed migration never reaches ready; verify migrated repositories remove empty legacy directories and inspect as migration_uncommitted then ready after commit.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/storage_layout_migration.ts: readPendingMigrationMarker does not validate source/target containment, target and size types, allowed path mappings, or symlinked parent segments before resolve/read/delete, allowing a crafted recovery marker to access or delete paths outside the repository; verify escaped, malformed, and symlink-parent entries fail before any relocation.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/commands/kernel.ts: intent validate and audit --legacy bypass inspectStorageLayout, so they do not report migration/recovery requirements through the shared zero-write gate; verify both commands return the layout requirement without reading task or legacy authority bytes.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/legacy_audit.ts: legacyLedgerSourceRelative falls back to the live old-authority .imm/memory/current_iteration.json path, contrary to the audit-only archived source contract; verify explicit legacy audit reads only .imm/audit/legacy-v3 and an unmigrated old Ledger is reported solely as a layout condition.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/storage_paths.ts: legacy Kernel transaction markers are classified as recovery_required, but the Spec requires migration_blocked_active and prior-runtime settlement; distinguish old markers from recoverable new-layout markers.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/storage_paths.ts: migration_uncommitted is only returned when .imm/audit exists, so cleanup-only migrations that delete MEMORY.md, templates, or an owner-free workspace can immediately return ready before their affected diff is committed; classify any dirty affected path as migration_uncommitted.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/storage_layout_migration.ts: fresh migration does not reject symlinked target parent segments, allowing .imm/audit/<task-id> or legacy-v3 parent symlinks to redirect writes outside the repository; validate every frozen source and target path before marker creation and relocation.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/storage.ts: terminal commit hashes and later deletes any present active-claim without proving it belongs to the settling task, while a null/omitted expected_claim_sha256 permits recovery to delete a newly present foreign claim; require an identity-matching claim and fail closed on absence or replacement.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/storage.ts: terminal marker and audit-pair validation accept a proof whose terminal_lifecycle contradicts the TaskRecord and accept non-null next workspace ownership, allowing contradictory evidence to become terminal authority; validate lifecycle equality and the required cleared workspace before convergence.

tests/kernel-storage-layout-migration.test.ts: the acceptance test never invokes migrateLegacyLayout, leaving dual-lock relocation, manifest replay, interruption recovery, collision handling, symlinked destinations, index preservation, and commit-before-retry behavior unverified; add direct migration and recovery cases.

tests/kernel-canary-terminal-transaction.test.ts: terminal tests cover marker-before-write and fully converged replay but do not interrupt after artifact relocation, audit record, proof, workspace clear, claim removal, or state-record removal; add deterministic failure injection at each settlement boundary and verify exact recovery.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/storage.ts: projectKernelAuthorityLocked classifies an audit pair plus a duplicate active state record as terminal_owner, or repairable_stale_claim when a matching claim also exists, instead of failing closed; detect any simultaneous state record and audit pair as authority_conflict and verify both claim/no-claim duplicate cases.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/storage.ts: terminal markers accept a missing/null expected_claim_sha256 and recovery then removes any present claim without identity verification, allowing a foreign claim to be deleted or a missing-claim authority conflict to terminalize; require an exact task-matching claim hash for terminal settlement and reject unexpected claim presence during replay.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/storage_layout_migration.ts: readPendingMigrationMarker accepts any source below broad legacy prefixes and permits target:null, so a forged or corrupted ignored marker can delete unknown files during recovery; validate every entry against the exact emitted source-to-target mapping, including duplicate and case-collision checks, before relocation.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/storage_layout_migration.ts: buildManifest relocates records and proofs independently and explicitly accepts record-only terminal records, allowing partial or contradictory legacy evidence to become an incomplete audit pair and eventually report ready; require a matching proof with task, lifecycle, and final-record-hash identity before writing the marker.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/storage_layout_migration.ts: case-fold collision detection covers only generated entries while existing audit targets are checked by exact spelling, so committed .imm/audit/foo evidence does not block migrating Foo on a case-sensitive filesystem; compare generated targets against existing audit paths case-insensitively before any write.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/storage_paths.ts: legacy Kernel transaction markers set both pending_marker and blocked_active, but inspectStorageLayout prioritizes pending_marker and reports recovery_required even though the new runtime cannot recover them; return migration_blocked_active with prior-runtime guidance for old markers and update the focused assertion.
Review returned this acceptance boundary twice; a durable replan is required.
